Through the prism of the memories of the cadets themselves and the high command, in particular Generals Oleksandr Syrskyi and Anatoly Bargylevych , the authors debunk the historical myth of Kruty as a "tragic self-sacrifice", instead drawing a parallel with modernity and proving that both in 1918 and in 2022, the professional actions of young people became successful operations that won the state a critically important time.
